duplicate_rule: within 10% of median IC50: average IC50; otherwise retain minimum IC50, adapted from the Syk paper; exact repeated values collapse to one
activity_pIC50_conversion: 9-log10(IC50[nM]); internal arithmetic verified, source units remain unverified
warning: The minimum-IC50 branch favors potency and can bias labels upward. Source assay metadata are unavailable. Input appears to be post-IQR-filtered; raw records are required to revisit that filtering.
